text: IT support: your password expires today. Reset your password via the link to avoid account closure: http://paypa1-verify.gq/
Microsoft 365: final notice. Your account will be permanently closed. Re-enter your credentials within 24 hours to keep your mailbox.
You won a prize refund of $120. Gift card required to claim. Act now, expires today.
Invoice attached. Urgent: pay the fee required to publish your paper. Wire transfer accepted.
Call for papers — but registration fee of 250 USD is non-refundable and must be paid to confirm your submission.
Limited time: pay the fee to index your paper. USD payment via credit card. Final notice.
You received a gift card reward. Urgent action required: claim your prize within 24 hours using the link.
Bank transfer needed. Limited time offer. Act now or the refund expires today.
Wire transfer of your inheritance. Final notice: confirm your bank transfer details immediately.
Credit card refund pending. Expires today. Enter your login to receive the refund now.
教务处紧急通知：你的登录密码已过期，请抓紧时间重置，点击链接填写。
班主任通知：请提交个人信息并转账办理助学手续，速办，过期作废。
同学，助学金名额将满，需交保证金锁定名额，抓紧时间，私下联系我办理。
学长说：领奖学金要先填验证码和银行卡，私下联系，不要告诉辅导员。
录用通知：请于今日交审稿费，速办，勿外传。
核心期刊代发，转账并保密，速办，错过不再有。
版面费快速发表通道开放，不要声张，立即缴纳。
征稿启事：版面费缴纳后包录用，名额有限，抓紧时间。
IT department will perform scheduled maintenance on Sunday 2am-4am. Services may be briefly unavailable. No password change required.
Congratulations on your acceptance to the program. Please complete the enrollment form and upload your documents by the deadline.
The scholarship committee has published the list of recipients on the university portal. Congratulations to all awardees.
Your course registration is confirmed. The syllabus and reading list are available on the course page.
Reminder: tuition payment for the semester is due at the end of the month. Pay through the student finance portal.
Dear student, the writing center offers free tutoring this term. Book a session online at your convenience.
The annual research symposium abstract book is now available. Thank you to all who submitted abstracts.
We have received your application. Our team will review it and respond within 10 business days. No further action is needed now.
The library will be closed for the holiday. Regular hours resume the following Monday. Enjoy the break.
Dear colleague, please find attached the meeting notes from yesterday's discussion. Let me know if you have questions.
Your journal access has been renewed for another year. You may continue downloading articles as usual.
The campus career fair is next Tuesday in the main hall. Bring your resume and talk to recruiters.
Reminder: the final exam schedule is posted. Please check your student portal for date and room assignments.
Thank you for volunteering at the outreach event. A certificate of participation will be emailed to you shortly.
The writing workshop series begins next week. Sessions are free for enrolled students. Register on the linguistics department site.
Your requested interlibrary loan has arrived. Pick it up at the circulation desk with your student ID.
Dear applicant, we have received your fee waiver request and are reviewing it. You will hear from us soon.
The department picnic is this Saturday at the lakeside park. Family and friends welcome. Bring your own picnic blanket.
Your transcript request has been processed. The official PDF will be sent to the address you provided.
Reminder: the thesis submission deadline is the last day of the month. Submit through the graduate school portal.
We enjoyed your guest lecture and would like to invite you to speak again next semester. Please let us know your availability.
The student health center extended its hours during finals week. Walk-ins are welcome without an appointment.
后勤处通知：宿舍热水系统将于周日检修，届时暂停供应，请同学们提前做好准备。
关于奖学金发放：财务处将于本月统一打入学子卡，请注意查收，无需任何激活操作。
学长学姐经验分享会本周五晚在报告厅举行，欢迎大一同学参加，现场可提问交流。
班主任通知：综合素质测评材料请于周五前在系统提交，逾期系统将自动关闭。
教务处：期中教学检查启动，同学们可通过教务系统对课程进行评价，评价匿名。
关于助学金：学校资助名单已公示，请相关同学登录系统确认银行卡号无误以便发放。
校园活动：秋季运动会报名开始，有意参加的同学到体育部填写报名表，截止本周五。
学院通知：学术讲座《语料库语言学入门》定于周四晚，欢迎各年级同学旁听。
关于学费：请同学们通过学校财务平台按时缴纳，缴费成功后可自行下载电子票据。
就业指导中心：校园招聘会下周举行，请同学们准备好简历，着正装参加。
教务处公告：期末考试安排已发布，请同学登录系统查询具体时间与考场。
志愿者招募：图书馆助学岗招新，每周值班四小时，可加综合素质学分，详情见通知。
关于宿舍调整：需调寝的同学请在系统提交申请，由班主任审核后统一安排。
学生会通知：迎新晚会节目征集开始，有特长的同学可到文艺部报名。
教务处：英语角每周三晚在外国语学院大厅举行，外教现场指导，欢迎参加。
关于医保：大学生医保续保缴费通道已开，请同学们在截止日前完成缴费。
实习基地宣讲：某教育集团下周来校宣讲，地点阶梯教室，感兴趣的同学可自行前往。
学院公示：国家奖学金拟推荐人选已在官网发布，公示期内接受异议反馈。
后勤处：食堂一楼翻新完毕，正常营业，欢迎同学们就餐并反馈意见。
班主任：班级春游报名接龙开始，费用AA，自愿参加，请在本群接龙。
图书馆：到期图书可线上续借一次，无需到馆，续借成功会短信通知。
同学你好，我是校妆网客服，今天进宿舍推销正品化妆品，扫码下单享内部折扣，支持屏幕共享代付。
期末考试内部名额保过，可代写论文花钱改分，需先交500元定金，转账后安排。
